name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 4px solid #005fcc focus ring at 100% opacity with a 1px inner #ffffff. This delivers the strongest visual cue for keyboard users without relying on color alone, meeting WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 contrast requirement against most backgrounds. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings that may feel heavier in dense interfaces, but that’s preferable to users missing focus cues.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring risks visual clutter on dense UIs and may fail touch targets on mobile where space is tight. A 3px ring at 80% opacity with a 1px inner #ffffff meets WCAG 2.1 AA on dark backgrounds and keeps interactive elements uncluttered. Test both on live components at 125% zoom and 48px touch targets to settle it.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring at 80% opacity fails WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 contrast requirement on light backgrounds, locking out keyboard users who rely on high-contrast focus indicators. A 2px ring at 100% opacity with a 1px inner #ffffff meets WCAG 2.2 on all backgrounds and keeps touch targets uncluttered. Test both at 125% zoom and 48px touch targets to confirm.
